deploy-hardened.name: Hardened EC2 Spot Deployment
deploy-hardened.rationale: Core AI inference engine. Required if no existing AI scanning infrastructure.

inference-logger.name: Inference Audit Logging
inference-logger.rationale: APRA requirement: 7-year audit trail of AI decisions. Critical if not already logging.

weekly-rollup.name: Weekly Log Aggregation
weekly-rollup.rationale: Cost optimization. Reduces S3 costs via batching and Glacier transition.

github-actions.name: CI/CD Security Scanning
github-actions.rationale: Automated validation. Replaces expensive external red teams for routine scanning.

s3-lifecycle.name: S3 Lifecycle Management
s3-lifecycle.rationale: Required for APRA 7-year retention at minimum cost (Glacier).

governance-workflow.name: Manual Governance Process
governance-workflow.rationale: Critical gap: Board oversight documentation. Required if no formal approval process.
